dataList.content:
We entered the worn-down building of L Corp.'s branch facility.
我们进入了被称作脑叶公司支部的破旧建筑中。
dataList.place:
District 4 - L Corp. Branch Interior
4区 脑叶公司支部内某处

dataList.content:
The deeper we advanced into the dark ahead, the awful stench rising from the underground floor only grew stronger.
随着光线逐渐黯淡，从地下传来的恶臭愈发强烈。

Urgh... The smell... It’s awful...
呜呃……气味……好重……

Mm... I can feel the waste collecting in my lungs.
唔……能感到污秽在肺中沉积。

The odor is so intense, it circles back around to refreshing.
这气味反而有助于头脑清醒。

Let me warn you one last time: If you die here, Dante won’t be able to revive you even when the battle has finished.
请允许我最后警告各位一次。如果你们死在这里，即便战斗结束，但丁也无法让你们复活。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
Revive...?
复活……？

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
Must be a popular joke or something~ Whew, I can’t even follow the kind of stories that are going around in the City these days~
这一定是最近流行的什么笑话吧~呼，我最近都不知道都市里又流传着什么故事了~

They seem to have misunderstood us, but seeing as Faust made no comment on it, I decided not to add my input...
好像产生了一些误会，但浮士德看起来并不打算特地解释，我也决定束手旁观。

... because we could now almost make out the sources of the rancid smell before our eyes.
因为比起那些，这萦绕鼻腔的恶臭的源头已经映入了我的眼中。

<Looks like they've been dead for a while.>
<看起来他们死了很久了。>

An astute observation, Executive Manager. The corpses have reached the stage of active decay.
真是正确的观察。尸体看上去已经进入了快速腐败期。

Bleh. The bugs are having a feast over there.
哎呀，虫子们正在大快朵颐呢。

... Let’s just hurry along.
……快走吧。

Huh... Something up, Gregor babe? Are you scared of bugs?
嗯……格雷格？你害怕虫子吗？

... Now, while I believe you're not so immature as to shove dead bugs in people's faces...
……哈，我相信你是个成熟的人，不会做拿死虫子贴到别人脸上这么幼稚的事……

Boo!!!
锵！！！

But just in case one of y― Gah! Put it away! You think that's funny?!
但是以防万一……啊啊！快把它拿走！这有什么好玩的？
Pfft... I mean, it is hilarious~ Who would’ve thought that you of all people’d be scared of these creepy-crawlies... 噗……太好玩了~谁会想到怕虫子的不是别人，而是你……

... Greg? Did it bother you that much?
……格雷格？你有这么讨厌它吗？

... Forget it.
……算了。

You there! Stop with your mischief this instant. Do not cause additional concerns for our manager!
那边的！别再恶作剧了，少给经理增添不必要的麻烦！

Hold on... this body here, it's still warm.
等等……这具尸体还留有余温。

Such is the sign of a recent attack.
说明其刚被袭击不久。

The gloom that had cast over Yuri’s face cleared after observing the bodies.
仔细观察了一会儿尸体后，尤莉脸上的阴霾逐渐散去了。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
These aren’t our... I mean, Lobotomy Corporation’s employees.
这不是我们……我是说，不是脑叶公司的员工。

I heard these buried facilities are considered pure goldmines now, attracting all sorts looking for a jackpot.
我听说这里似乎已经被当成了宝地，所以什么样的人都涌过来了。

Phrases like the “Lobotomy Dream” or the “Enkephalin Rush” are apparently starting to catch on among Fixers and Syndicates.
在收尾人和帮派之间，肯定流行起了像是“脑叶梦”或是“脑啡肽热潮”这样的词。

LD, E-Rush... Got a nice ring to it...
脑·梦，脑·潮……真是不错的略语……

*sigh* Really appreciate the input. Totally worth the long silence.
唉，你这么久不说话，刚一开口就是这个吗……

Is such a frivolous use of English not prone to blurring the original meaning?
如此随意地使用略语，不会模糊原意吗？

That’s what I’m sayi―
这就是我想说……

Huh, you seem to be talking a lot more than usual, Yi Sang.
李箱先生，你似乎话比平时多不少啊？

Does that reflect strangely?
有何异常？

He was never really the quiet sort.
他原本就不是寡言的人。

He only had a... shift recently.
只是最近……变了一些。

It’s not a bad thing to have more lackeys with keen eyes.
能多一个观察力敏锐的下属总是好的。

I’d like you to keep that up. Let us march.
希望你继续保持。前进吧。

You make yourself look like the captain here. I dare say that role belongs to the manager.
你似乎将自己置于队长之位了。我以为那是经理的职责。

... Please forgive my insolence, Executive Manager.
……是我越界了。经理。

Frowning as though she were caught off-guard, Outis bows to me as she apologizes.
奥提斯一副手足无措的僵硬神情，立即向我鞠躬道歉。

<N-no, it’s nothing. Let’s head down.>
<没、没事的。继续向下走吧。>

Most of the corpses’ body parts were morphed in bizarre ways.
大部分尸体的一些部位都产生了奇怪的变化。

One had insect wings protruding through their intestines, and another had horribly twisted antennae hanging down.
比如从肠子里伸出几对翅膀，或是扭曲成了怪异的形状而垂下的可怕触角。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
These look kinda similar to the thugs we ran into just before, don’t they?
是不是有点像我们之前遇到过的暴徒？

You mean those bug-headed people?
你是说、那些虫脑袋？

Quiet, I’m seeing Uniform Tangos ahead.
安静，前方发现举异者。

As Outis noted, multiple figures could be seen down the corridor.
正如奥提斯所说，走廊的另一端可以看到很多人影。
(Uniform... what? What's that?) （举异……者？是什么啊？）

(Unidentified targets... Possibly hostile.)
（举动异常者……说不定是敌人。）

I’m sure we all had the same idea as to what Outis was referring to:
我确信我们都冒出了一个同样的想法。

The enigmatic "Abnormalities" that might be roaming this facility, as Faust mentioned.
之前浮士德提到的，可能正在设施里游荡的，神秘的“异想体”。

That might be what those shadowy figures are.
那大概就是这些身影的真身。

... We have no choice but to face them.
……只能直面它们了。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
Hey! Who goes there?!
喂！谁在那里？！

What we confronted weren't the creatures we'd anticipated, but people.
然而，我们面对的却是人类。

It was too early to be relieved, though.
虽然尚不知该不该对此感到庆幸。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
Huh? I thought we were the only people ‘round here.
什么？我听说这附近就剩我们几个了。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
Did they slip past our team at the entrance? These scavengers keep coming one after the other.
入口那边没能处理掉吗？看样子是在这期间有其他老鼠混进来了。

Oi, bug buggers! You friends with the bodies back there?
喂，臭虫们！刚才那边的尸体是你们的朋友吗？

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
Bodies?! You bastards didn’t...
尸体？！你们这帮混蛋……

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
Wait.
等等。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
... I don't know what hole you scum crawled out of, but hear me out.
……我不知道你们这帮垃圾是哪来的，但是给我听好。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
You’re here for the Enkephalin, aren’t ya? If you go just one floor down, there’s a treasure trove just waiting to be nabbed.
反正你们来这儿肯定也是为了脑啡肽吧？只要你们再下一层楼，就能轻松得手了。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
Whatever’s on that floor is yours. We’ll just take what we can here and be on our...
那里就让给你们了。我们彼此各取所需，友好道别……

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
... way. Ha, Haha.
……吧。哈、哈哈。

Tsk, so you recognized me, huh.
啧，还是认出我了。

The moment the soldier’s eyes landed on Gregor’s face...
如他所言，原本想要和平解决的那人的表情……

Their thin veil of affability crumbled.
在看见格里高尔的那一瞬间就立刻崩溃了。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
You fucking traitor...
你这卑鄙的叛徒……

Ahh, you must’ve been dispatched to the front lines too. Don't I look better in real life than I do on those flyers?
啊，你应该也上过前线吧。怎么样，真正的我看上去比传单上要好多了吧？

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
Cut the crap! I can't believe I used to salute to your face.
去你妈的！我一想到曾经对着你的脸敬过礼，就恶心得要死。

Whoa, easy there, it’s not like you had to salute me in person.
哎呀，又不需要你对着真人敬礼，就别这么说了。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
You didn't suffer from a single side effect, did you? You got to live a normal life, all thanks to that damned privilege of yours.
你倒是靠着你那屁大点的特权，摆脱掉手术的副作用，像个正常人一样生活起来了……

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
We never even got a chance, you two-faced piece of shit. They discarded us like trash the moment we lost the war.
我们可完全不一样，你这混帐骗子。刚一战败我们就全被舍弃了。

... I was tossed out all the same, you know. Isn’t that a soldier's life? To be discarded?
……我也一样被抛弃了。所有军人不都一样吗？

And I see where you decided to take your life from there, rifling through trash and gunk like actual vermin.
在这之中，你们似乎选择了像被舍弃的虫子一样生存下去吧？

Halt! No good can come out of taunting your foe!
喂！挑衅敌人没有任何好处！

You served in the military too. Y’know where this is going.
同为军队出身的你应该心知肚明。

We’re not getting outta this without a fight.
我们是否要与眼前的这些家伙战斗。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
... We were planning to let you through, we really were.
……本想放你们乖乖离开的。

dataList.title:
G Corp. Remnant
没落的G公司
dataList.content:
But now, I’m gonna make mincemeat out of you and your traitor friend.
但现在我要把那个混账叛徒切个稀碎。

Like hell you were. You were gonna wait for us to climb back up with the Enkephalin so you could backstab us and swipe it.
一群蠢货。如果我们真把脑啡肽拿来了，你们肯定会在背后捅一刀吧。

W-wait, were they?
他、他们是这么想的吗？

They’ve smashed right past rock bottom a long time ago. Don't expect 'em to care a whit for honor, eh?
就这么一群堕落到底边中的底边里的东西，你觉得他们还能讲究什么义气？

Well-off or broke, people turn on each other as long as there’s something. You’re way too naive to think otherwise.
哪怕是那些稍好一些的家伙也会在背后捅人刀子。你最好是别有什么天真的期待。
